text:
Maria: Drafting the alpha handoff + private-preview recruitment plan. Need a quick sync on invite timing, acceptance criteria, and feedback cadence. Who can own outreach and partner success?

Aj: I can weigh in on feasibility. Main constraints: eng bandwidth for integrations and telemetry hooks. We should avoid heavy SDK work for alpha — prefer hosted workflows. :+1:

Sophie: I'll own the onboarding UX and welcome flow. Suggest two onboarding templates: a) sandbox (no infra changes), b) integration (minimal config).

Tariq: CS can support up to ~8 partners in parallel. Recommend we segment into two tracks (sandbox vs integrated) and cap integrations to 3 for alpha. I'll run partner comms.

Maria: Proposal: outreach window 1 week open, accept 6–8 partners, commitment ask = 4 wks of active feedback + 2 async surveys. Weekly 30m check-ins + async Looms and a shared Miro board. Thoughts?

Aj: Sounds good. For telemetry we need event hooks for: `session_start`, `prompt_submission`, `model_variant`, `latency_ms`, `error_type`, `feedback_marker`. Can we keep event schema minimal? Example payload:```json
{
  "event":"prompt_submission",
  "session_id":"<uuid>",
  "variant":"redwood-v1/quantized",
  "tokens_out":120
}
```

Sophie: Add a simple QA checklist for partners to run before check-ins: 1) run sample prompt set, 2) validate latency SLA for core routes, 3) save 3 examples of bad outputs. I'll drop the checklist into the doc.

Tariq: On success criteria: recommend three measurable gates: - onboarding completion rate >= 80% within 3 days - weekly active session >= 2 per partner - qualitative signal: at least 3 actionable product asks from partners by week 4.

Maria: Love those. I'll add a lightweight NPS touch at week 4 and a regression flag: if any partner reports >10% drop in quality on baseline evals we pause their integration.

Aj: Quick note on rollout: prioritize routing partners to hosted variants first, fallback to dedicated infra only if needed. That keeps ops overhead low for alpha.

Sophie: Invite copy draft (feel free to reuse):
```
Hi <PartnerName>,
We're inviting a small group to our private alpha of Redwood Inference. Commitment: 4 weeks active testing + short weekly check-ins. You'll get early access to performance tuning, direct product feedback channels, and a single POC contact. If interested reply with your preferred track: sandbox or integration.
Thanks!
Sophie (Design) & Maria (Product)
```

Maria: Action items: - Aj: define minimal telemetry schema + sample event lib by EOW - Sophie: onboarding checklist + invite copy final by Thu - Tariq: partner list + outreach schedule by Fri. Who can volunteer to manage the Miro board and collect Looms?

Tariq: I'll manage Miro and collect Looms. Will also coordinate calendar invites.

Maria: Great. I'll set a 30m kickoff for next Tue. @Aj can you confirm eng availability before I finalize calendar?

Aj: Confirmed — small spike ok next Tue morning US PST.

beta-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Alpha private-preview kickoff" Tue 10:00 PST (created by Maria).

Sophie: :party_parrot: Nice tempo. I'll add a short primer for partners on expected metrics and sample prompts.

Maria: Thanks all. I'll update the doc with these decisions and tag owners. If anyone thinks we should change the acceptance window or capacity, flag here.
